I have enough context. Answer below (docs read per AGENTS.md: code.md → component docs → connections, no raw source needed).

**Opened:** `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts`, via `openInventory()` using Angular Material's `MatDialog.open()` (left sidebar "Inventory" button). Note: it doesn't display centered (bugs.md B-14).

**Data passed:** an `InventoryDialogData` object (`{ characterId, sessionId }`) injected into `InventoryComponent` via `MAT_DIALOG_DATA`.

**API calls the dialog can make** (all through `game-api.service.ts`, hitting `worker/src/routes/character.ts`):
- `getInventory(characterId)` → `GET /api/character/:id` (loaded on open, written to local signal + `CharacterStateService`)
- `equipItem(characterId, itemId, equipped)` → `PATCH /api/character/:id/equip` (equip/unequip weapon or armor)
- `dropItem(characterId, itemId)` → `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` (drop, or "use" a potion to consume one unit)

Note: "Use Potion" healing is computed client-side and never persisted (bugs.md B-05) — the Worker doesn't see the heal roll.
